name: 2.5D Grid Traversal with Z-interpolation
definition: A method to traverse a 2D grid where each cell has a min/max height range, by extending a 2D DDA algorithm to calculate the Z-coordinate at each cell entry/exit to check for overlap with the cell's height range.
summary: 2.5D Grid Traversal with Z-interpolation extends 2D DDA to calculate Z-coordinates at cell boundaries, enabling efficient culling of height-field cells while avoiding Bresenham's errors.
